zh.title: 你怎样定义成功的人生？
zh.intro: 没有标准答案。点选最接近你想法的选项，一起分享与思考。

questions.question: 你觉得什么才算成功的人生？
options: 赚很多钱，实现财务自由
拥有理想的工作和事业
让父母感到骄傲
拥有幸福的家庭和生活
完成神给我的使命

questions.question: 你认为谁的人生更成功？
options: 月入RM20,000，事业成功，但压力很大
月入RM5,000，生活稳定，有时间陪伴家人和服事神
两个人都可能成功，取决于人生的价值观

questions.question: 巴别塔的人努力建造高塔，希望传扬自己的名。你认为他们最大的问题是什么？
options: 他们太有野心
他们只想荣耀自己，而不是神
他们不应该追求成功
他们不应该一起合作

questions.question: 如果10年后你已经成功了，你最希望自己成为怎样的人？
options: 有钱、有地位的人
能让家人骄傲的人
活得快乐、满足的人
能荣耀神、帮助别人的人

zh.summary: 真正的成功，不只是我们取得多少成就，而是我们如何使用神赐给我们的恩赐，荣耀神并成为别人的祝福。

en.title: How do you define a successful life?
en.intro: There are no right or wrong answers. Choose what best reflects your thoughts, then share and reflect together.

questions.question: What do you think makes a successful life?
options: Earning a lot of money and achieving financial freedom
Having my ideal job and career
Making my parents proud
Having a happy family and life
Fulfilling God's calling for my life

questions.question: Whose life do you consider more successful?
options: Someone earning RM20,000 a month with a successful career, but under a lot of stress
Someone earning RM5,000 a month with a stable life and time for family and serving God
Either person could be successful, depending on their values

questions.question: The people at Babel worked hard to build a tall tower and make a name for themselves. What do you think was their biggest problem?
options: They were too ambitious
They wanted to glorify themselves rather than God
They should not have pursued success
They should not have worked together

questions.question: If you are successful in 10 years, what kind of person would you most want to be?
options: Someone wealthy and influential
Someone who makes their family proud
Someone who is happy and content
Someone who glorifies God and helps others

en.summaryTitle: A thought to take with you
en.summary: True success is not just about how much we achieve, but how we use the gifts God has given us to glorify Him and be a blessing to others.
